title: RTA: per-endpoint p95/p99 latency insights and historical regression view
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a real-time and historical latency insights surface that exposes p95 and p99 latency per API route / model variant / region, wired into the existing load/regression harness. This ticket covers metric naming, ingestion path, dashboard templates, alert rules for regressions, and integrating synthetic load scenarios so that regressions are visible and actionable by SRE/Runtime/PM teams. The goal is a single view for: 1) short-term operational triage (last 1h, 6h) and 2) medium-term regression analysis (7d rolling, 90d trends) with links to the load harness runs that produced the data.
acceptance_criteria: p95 and p99 time-series available in Prometheus/TSDB with labels: route, model, region, priority_tier
Daily dashboard template created in Grafana with panels for: p50/p95/p99, request rate, tokens/sec, error rate, and rolling-regression flags
Synthetic-run metadata (harness run id, scenario, target qps, seed prompts) attached to time ranges on the dashboard
Automated regression detector emits an incident event when p99 increases > 30% over 7d baseline for a route-model-region combination
Performance dashboard documented in the observability playbook and accessible via Console links
implementation_steps: Define metric schema and labels: latency_bucketed and latency_quantiles exported from runtime (metric names: rtw_latency_ms, rtw_latency_quantile) with labels: route, model, region, seq_len_bucket, batch_size
Add runtime export for p95/p99 as summary metrics and histograms; ensure no high-cardinality labels (limit model to model_family/model_version only)
Hook exporter into Prometheus pushgateway for synthetic harness runs; stream production metrics to Prometheus and rollups to ClickHouse for long-term storage
Create Grafana dashboard template (initial JSON in /dashboards/perf/p95-p99-by-endpoint.json) and wire to team dashboards namespace
Implement regression-detector job (cron) that compares 7d baseline to last 24h using ClickHouse OLAP queries and publishes findings to Slack/Incidents
Instrument regression harness to annotate runs with run_id and scenario tags so dashboards can filter to harness traffic
Run staged rollout: dev cluster -> canary region -> global. Confirm metric fidelity and query performance at each stage
metrics: harness_run_id and harness_scenario attached as annotation labels for synthetic traffic
dashboard_widgets: Overview row: current p50/p95/p99 by route (heatmap) for selected region/model
Heatmap: p95 delta vs baseline (7d) with color thresholds (green <5%, amber 5-30%, red >30%)
Timeseries: tokens/sec and request throughput aligned with p95/p99 for correlation
Panel: top 10 route+model combinations by p99 increase over baseline
Table: recent regression-detector alerts with link to harness_run and correlated PRs
Annotation band: show harness run intervals with metadata on the time axis
alerting: Regression detector creates an alert if p99_recent > 1.3 * p99_baseline for the same route+model+region over 7d baseline
Operational alert if p95 > latency_slo(route) for 5 minutes and request rate > 5rps
Alert payload includes graph link, last 1h quantiles, and harness_run_id if applicable
testing_plan: Unit tests for exporter changes to ensure labels are present and cardinality limits enforced
Integration test: run regression harness (scenario: long-context token-heavy) and verify annotations appear in dashboard
Load test: simulate 3 traffic profiles (small prompt, long prompt, streaming) at target QPS and validate p95/p99 compute latency correctness
Canary evaluation: enable metric exporters in a single canary region and run synthetic load for 24h, review metric cardinality and storage costs
